searchText: Because it needs to be signed to the specific builder otherwise any builder would be able to send registrations to other builders. Registrations could be skipped but then things like gas limit voting would be broken. do we expect the same proposer to send different gas limit to different builders? if not, there's nothing wrong regs get reused across builders

Registrations could be skipped but then things like gas limit voting would be broken.
